subject.title: [Bug]: channels status --deep falsely reports not-running for an auto-loaded (no plugins.allow) channel plugin

question: Should `channels status` present allowlist/configuration eligibility as a distinct state, or should the command be changed to obtain and display authoritative gateway runtime liveness for auto-loaded channel plugins?
rationale: The report demonstrates an operator-facing mismatch, but choosing the durable meaning of a status health field affects the CLI diagnostic contract and plugin/runtime ownership boundary.

options.title: Separate configured and runtime states
options.body: Keep configuration validation visible but label it independently from actual process/channel liveness when a plugin is auto-loaded.

options.title: Define health as configuration readiness
options.body: Retain the current semantics but document clearly that the health line is configuration-derived rather than a runtime-liveness assertion.

recommendation.title: Separate configured and runtime states
recommendation.body: Keep configuration validation visible but label it independently from actual process/channel liveness when a plugin is auto-loaded.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has the only concrete live reproduction in the available evidence and can help verify the chosen contract against the observed plugin setup.
